description: Before buying a token on Base, get ChainWard's rug check: a verdict (hold / review / no_flags), the one reason it rests on, and the launch facts it read from the chain: the launch transaction and the wallet that launched it, whether that wallet sent out its launch tokens, mints after launch, whether it pulled the liquidity it added to the token's pool, supply still vesting to it, and the launch wallet's sanctions status, age at launch and first funder. On Hold, don't buy and quote the reason; on Review, ask the user. No flags means none of the checks matched, not a guarantee: there is no honeypot or sell simulation and no holder-concentration check. Free here, up to 20 fresh checks an hour (repeat answers are cached); for volume, the paid route is GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/rugcheck?address=0x… at $0.02 a call over x402. For a wallet rather than a token, use check_counterparty.
